text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Fees (Department of Broadcasting

Malaysia) (Validation) Act 2023.

Validation and indemnity

2. (1) Notwithstanding the provisions of the Fees Act 1951 [Act 209],

the fees which were charged and collected by the Department

of Broadcasting Malaysia in respect of any supply of television

programme during the period from 15 March 2001 to 28 February 2022

shall be deemed to have been validly charged and collected.

LAWS OF MALAYSIA

Act 848

FEES (DEPARTMENT OF BROADCASTING MALAYSIA)

(VALIDATION) ACT 2023
4 Laws of Malaysia

(2) No action or legal proceedings shall be brought or

instituted against the Government of Malaysia, any officer

of the Government of Malaysia or any person acting under the directions

of any officer of the Government of Malaysia in respect of any fees

which were charged and collected during the period referred to in

subsection (1), and if any such action or legal proceedings has

been brought or instituted, it shall be discharged and made

void, and no refund in respect of the fees charged and collected

as specified in this Act shall be made.
